Body.Content:
We are announcing the ability to evaluate alert rules and review supported metrics for business-critical resources every hour in Monitor, helping admins identify potential issues sooner. This feature will enter public preview on November 23, 2026.

How does this affect me?
When creating or editing an alert rule for a supported app, flow, or agent, admins can set the Data review period to 1 hour. Monitor will evaluate the selected metric after new hourly data becomes available, and the alert can trigger when the configured threshold is crossed. Admins can also switch the metric chart to an hourly view to review activity from the previous 24 hours. These alerts follow an hourly evaluation schedule and are not real-time alerts.

The following products and metrics are supported in the Power Platform admin center experience of Monitor:
  • Canvas and code apps : Time to interactive, app open success rate, data request latency, and data request success rate
  • Model-driven apps : App open success rate
  • Cloud flows : Success rate
  • Copilot Studio agents : Agent session success rate
The following metrics are supported for Copilot Managed Runtime apps in the Microsoft 365 admin center experience of Monitor:
  • Time to interactive
  • App open success rate
  • Data request latency
  • Data request success rate
  • App session count
Low-latency alert rules apply to individual resources and metrics. Only one hourly rule can be configured for each resource and metric, and each tenant can configure up to 10 hourly rules in each supported admin experience. Hourly rules that are turned off continue to count toward this limit. For Power Platform resources, low-latency alerts use resource scope and require the resource to be in a Managed Environment.

What action do I need to take?
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

If you choose to use this feature, consider configuring hourly alert rules for the business-critical resources where identifying an issue on the same day is most important.

For more information about this feature, please visit:
  • Create alerts for your Power Platform resources
  • Monitor apps in the Microsoft 365 admin center

message.Title: Low-latency alerts and metrics in Monitor
